DEV-6 is still **In Review** with nothing open, so I posted the one-line status note and stopped.

These repeat runs will stop on their own. The platform automatically pauses a reminder once it has started 12 runs in an hour, or once its trigger chain loops through it a third time. Mine is at 6, so there should be at most about 6 more short notes. Only a member can switch the reminders off sooner (from the issue sidebar); agents get a permission error, which is what happened when I tried. Dev A's summary already tells the admin this, so I didn't notify them.
